name: reminders-skill
description: Saves reminders with an optional time, lists them, and tells you which ones are now due. Reminders are saved between sessions.

intents.description: Set a reminder for a task, optionally at a time; list saved reminders; or ask what reminders are due.
example_utterances: Remind me to take my medicine at 8 pm
Set a reminder to call mom tomorrow
Remind me about the meeting at 3 pm
Do I have any reminders due?
